summary_en: Ordinary dividend ¥43/share (up from ¥42); special dividend ¥39/share. Full-year FY2026 dividend ¥82/share. Payout ratio target 50%+. Special dividend sourced from ¥3.5B of M&A budget reallocation.
title_en: Notice on FY2026 December Period Consolidated Earnings Forecast Revision and Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase and Special Dividend)
translation_en_brief: AUCNET announced a revision to its FY2026 (calendar year ending 31 December 2026) consolidated earnings forecast and dividend policy on 4 August 2026. Upward revision to full-year operating profit to ¥12.0B (from ¥11.5B) and net income to ¥7.8B (from ¥7.5B) driven by stronger-than-expected performance in both the Lifestyle Products and Mobility & Energy segments in the first half, particularly digital products and used-vehicle auction businesses. Ordinary dividend for FY2026 raised to ¥43/share at period-end (from ¥42/share forecast), reflecting upward earnings revision. Additionally, company will pay special dividend of ¥39/share at period-end, funded by reallocation of ¥3.5B from the ¥7.0B M&A investment budget in the medium-term plan "Blueprint 2027", to enhance capital efficiency. Full-year dividend target ¥82/share. Company maintains payout ratio target of 50%+ and states remaining ¥3.5B M&A budget plus increased operating cash flow provide sufficient investment capacity for future growth opportunities.
